transcript: Bowen Yang is going to Broadway in the spring. I'm calling it now. I'm calling it now. Why else would you leave halfway through the season unless you had something you needed to do in the spring? There are some people suggesting he's joining the cast of oh Mary, which would make sense. I would love to see his Mary. I would love to see his Mary's husband, but I just. I don't think, especially with a hit show like oh Mary that's not closing anytime soon. I don't think you leave your final season of SNL to go do a replacement cast. I think he's joining the cast of a new show. So the question is, what is it? Is it Titanic? The first time I ever saw Titanic in the basement of Christie's, him and Matt Rogers were front row in the sailor hats. So could be that. I could it be Rocky Horror? I know Sam Pinkleton has definitely cast celebrities in his shows before, and there's a couple roles that I would love to see Bowen Yang do in Rocky Horror. That would be really fun. Honestly, a Bowen Yang Brad would be wild and I'd be here for it. But could it be a potentially a secret third thing? I don't know. There's a lot of celebrity driven plays this season coming in. Could he be part of one of those cast that has yet to announce yet? Could he be another show that is Yet to announce. I don't know, I, I don't know. But what I am pretty confident in is that we are going to see Bowen Yang in a Broadway show in the spring. I just, I feel it in my bones. I feel it in my bones.
classificationReason: Pure speculation/anticipation about Bowen Yang leaving SNL mid-season for a Broadway role. Mentions multiple shows (Oh Mary!, Titanique, Rocky Horror Show) as possibilities with no single show focus and no first-hand review of any production.
